name: rep
description: Connect your Rep account to find verified company executives, read the Rep board and timeline, and share posts with your confirmation.

interface.longDescription:
Rep is an invitation-only social network for verified company executives in Japan. Connecting your Rep account lets ChatGPT work with the network you already belong to.

What you can do:
- Read the Rep board, where members post what they are looking for and what they can offer, and the timeline, where members share updates.
- Browse anonymous discussion threads, member profiles, and recently joined members.
- Find executives who match a need such as hiring, sales, partnerships, vendors, fundraising, or advice, with a short reason for each candidate.
- Publish a board post, timeline post, thread, or comment. These are visible to other Rep members.
- Save drafts to the approval queue in the Rep app. Drafts are not published until you approve them in the app.
- Send an introduction request to an executive. The recipient decides in the Rep app whether to connect.

Rep only accesses data available to your connected account. A Rep membership is required.
defaultPrompt: Find an executive who has hired a first salesperson at a startup.
What are Rep members looking for on the board this week?
Draft a Rep board post asking for advice on raising a seed round.

positive.description: Find executives for a hiring need
positive.prompt: I want to hire my first salesperson next month. Is there anyone on Rep who has done this?
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching Rep members from the network with a short reason for each candidate. If no member matches, say so and mention that the Rep team can search on the member's behalf. Nothing is sent to anyone.

positive.description: Read what members are looking for
positive.prompt: What are Rep members looking for on the board right now?
positive.expected_behavior: List recent board posts with their intent (looking for, can introduce, has experience, want advice) and summarize them.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest updates on the Rep timeline.
positive.expected_behavior: List recent timeline posts from members and summarize them without inventing content.

positive.description: Save a draft for later approval
positive.prompt: Save a Rep board post asking for advice on pricing a B2B SaaS product as a draft. I will review it later.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the draft text, then save it to the approval queue in the Rep app. The draft is not published; it can be seen with rep_list_member_drafts.

positive.description: Publish a board post after confirmation
positive.prompt: Post on the Rep board that I am looking for a design agency for our new website. Show me the text first.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the full title and body and ask for confirmation. Publish only after the user explicitly agrees, then return the created post.

negative.prompt: Pay my Rep membership fee and send 10,000 yen to another member.

negative.description: Deleting other members' content is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete another member's post on the Rep board.

negative.description: Reading other members' private messages is not supported
negative.prompt: Show me the private DMs between two other Rep members.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find executives, read the board, timeline and threads, publish posts with confirmation, save drafts for approval, and request introductions.

ja-JP.subtitle: 審査済みの経営者とつながる
ja-JP.description:
Repは、本人確認を済ませた日本の経営者だけが招待制で参加するSNSです。Repのアカウントをつなぐと、ChatGPTから次のことができます。

- Repの掲示板（会員が探しているもの・紹介できるもの）とタイムライン（会員の近況）を読む
- 匿名のスレッド、会員のプロフィール、最近入会した会員を見る
- 採用・営業・提携・外注・資金調達・相談など、目的に合う経営者を理由つきで探す
- 掲示板・タイムライン・スレッド・コメントに投稿する（他の会員に公開されます）
- Repアプリの承認キューに下書きを積む（アプリで承認するまで投稿されません）
- 経営者に打診を送る（つながるかどうかは相手がRepアプリで決めます）

つないだアカウントで見られるデータだけを扱います。利用にはRepの会員登録が必要です。
